bindings.list: Authenticated listForIssue selects any Bot of the visible issue. FactoryTaskSummary exposes id, issueId, stage, status, revision, attemptId, candidateId. revision is the task version field, not version.
bindings.detail: Authenticated session -> actAs -> handleFactory -> factoryHumanStore.read selects the persisted Bot and checks task/issue ownership. Result body.task includes userId and the same task bindings.
bindings.workspace: Detail liveWorkspaceId is factoryLiveScopes(...).task.workspaceId. For a Bot task, this is the persisted Bot workspace with active owner membership. Null/unavailable scope is not proof.
bindings.listScope: List liveWorkspaceId comes from factoryIssueLiveScope and describes the issue list scope, which can differ from the persisted Bot workspace for a personal issue. It must not be used to exclude a task.
bindings.snapshotBoundary: The detail body and live scope are sequential reads in one HTTP handler, not an atomic database snapshot. This change only scopes the existing bounded preflight; it is not a lock or terminal-state proof.

guard: Only an unsettled task with exact list/detail identity, owner, revision, stage/status and attempt/candidate binding plus valid non-target workspace may be ignored by quiet(). Same/missing/invalid/mismatched proofs remain busy.
unchanged: issueInventory and baseline visible issue set
owned Factory cancellation and machine cleanup
